title: Best AI Website Builder for SaaS & Startup Marketing Sites in 2026
summary: We scored eight AI website builders on the eight things that matter to a startup's marketing site: a real waitlist and lead database, dev-friendly export, and speed, not a generic template.
body_markdown: They're both genuinely strong choices for a design-led marketing site with fast load times and precise visual control, especially if a dedicated designer is involved. Neither has a path to building the actual SaaS product on the same platform, so the product ends up on a separate stack, with a waitlist database that lives apart from the eventual app.
